sentences.gloss: I’m thirsty — I want some water.
I want to buy a small bag.
He has a lot of new books.

sentences.text: 我有一个很漂亮的房间。
sentences.gloss: I have a very beautiful room.
I’d like a cup of hot coffee.
He is an old friend of mine.

sentences.text: 那个年轻的女人是医生。
sentences.gloss: That young woman is a doctor.
That old man is my grandpa.
I want the big one, not the small one.
My dad has a new car.
Let’s go to a good restaurant.

sentences.text: 那辆蓝色的车是我爸爸的。
sentences.gloss: That blue car is my dad’s.

sentences.text: 我爸爸有一个棕色的包。
sentences.gloss: My dad has a brown bag.

sentences.text: 这个房间的墙是橘黄色的。
sentences.gloss: The walls of this room are orange.
The bedroom walls are light green.
I want the dark green one.
My older brother is taller than me.
My older brother isn’t as tall as me.
Today isn’t as cold as yesterday.

sentences.text: 这个房间比那个房间大。
sentences.gloss: This room is bigger than that one.

sentences.text: 这个房间没有那个房间大。
sentences.gloss: This room isn’t as big as that one.
Coffee is more expensive than tea.
Coffee isn’t as expensive as tea.
Is coffee more expensive than tea?
Planes are much faster than trains.
I’m two years older than my younger sister.
In our family my dad is the tallest.

sentences.text: 这是这个城市最大的公园。
sentences.gloss: This is the biggest park in the city.
I’m as tall as my older brother.
These two cups are the same size.

sentences.text: 坐出租车比坐公共汽车贵。
sentences.gloss: Taking a taxi costs more than taking the bus.
Red apples are dearer than green apples.
My phone is newer than yours.
This book is harder than that one.
August is the hottest month here.
This one is a bit dearer than that one.

sentences.text: 白色的车比黑色的车便宜吗？
sentences.gloss: Are white cars cheaper than black cars?
Today is even colder than yesterday.

sentences.text: 这个包很漂亮，可是很贵。
sentences.gloss: This bag is pretty, but it’s expensive.

sentences.text: 我喜欢茶，但是我不喜欢咖啡。
sentences.gloss: I like tea, but I don’t like coffee.

sentences.text: 因为今天很冷，所以我们不去公园。
sentences.gloss: Because it’s cold today, we aren’t going to the park.

sentences.text: 因为我饿了，所以我想吃饭。
sentences.gloss: Because I’m hungry, I want to eat.

sentences.text: 我很渴，所以我喝了很多水。
sentences.gloss: I was thirsty, so I drank a lot of water.

sentences.text: 因为火车比汽车快，所以我们坐火车去。
sentences.gloss: Because trains are faster than cars, we’re going by train.

sentences.text: 我们吃午饭，然后去公园。
sentences.gloss: We’ll have lunch, then go to the park.

sentences.text: 我去超市买牛奶，然后回家。
sentences.gloss: I’m going to the supermarket to buy milk, then home.

sentences.text: 我妈妈做饭，然后我们一起吃。
sentences.gloss: My mum cooks, then we eat together.
When I’m tired, I have a coffee.

sentences.text: 我小的时候很喜欢喝牛奶。
sentences.gloss: When I was little I loved drinking milk.

sentences.text: 我回家的时候，妈妈在做饭。
sentences.gloss: When I got home, Mum was cooking.

sentences.text: 他来的时候，我们都很高兴。
sentences.gloss: When he came, we were all very happy.

sentences.text: 如果明天冷，我们就不去公园。
sentences.gloss: If it’s cold tomorrow, we won’t go to the park.

sentences.text: 如果明天不冷，我们就去公园。
sentences.gloss: If it isn’t cold tomorrow, we’ll go to the park.

sentences.text: 如果你饿了，我们就去吃饭。
sentences.gloss: If you’re hungry, we’ll go and eat.
alts: 你如果饿了，我们就去吃饭。

sentences.text: 如果你想去，我们明天去北京。
sentences.gloss: If you want to go, we’ll go to Beijing tomorrow.
alts: 如果你想去，明天我们去北京。

sentences.text: 明天不冷的话，我们去公园。
sentences.gloss: If it isn’t cold tomorrow, we’re going to the park.

sentences.text: 虽然这个房子很小，但是很漂亮。
sentences.gloss: Although this house is small, it is pretty.

sentences.text: 他虽然很累，可是很高兴。
sentences.gloss: Although he is tired, he is happy.
alts: 虽然他很累，可是很高兴。

sentences.text: 虽然咖啡很贵，但是我每天都喝。
sentences.gloss: Although coffee is expensive, I drink it every day.

sentences.text: 我饿了，所以我想吃面包。
sentences.gloss: I’m hungry, so I want to eat some bread.

sentences.text: 我不饿，所以我不想吃面包。
sentences.gloss: I’m not hungry, so I don’t want to eat any bread.

sentences.text: 因为这家饭馆很便宜，所以我们常常去。
sentences.gloss: Because this restaurant is cheap, we go there often.
He goes to the bank, then to the post office.
